headword: {有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}

definitions.explanation: In chemistry, a compound whose molecules are based on carbon (with the conventional exception of a few simple carbon compounds such as carbon dioxide). Contrasts with inorganic compounds.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}は{有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}だ。
{有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}は{炭素|たんそ}を{含|ふく}んでいる。
この{研究室|けんきゅうしつ}では{新|あたら}しい{有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}の{合成|ごうせい}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: This laboratory is working on synthesizing new organic compounds.

notes:
A basic term in chemistry. The defining feature is a carbon skeleton; living things and the substances derived from them are made largely of organic compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}の{合成|ごうせい}: synthesis of organic compounds
- {揮発性|きはつせい}{有機化合物|ゆうきかごうぶつ}: volatile organic compound (VOC)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無機化合物|むきかごうぶつ}: inorganic compound — the contrasting category
- {化合物|かごうぶつ}: compound — the general term for a substance of two or more elements
